issue.title: Stabilize retry E2E PNG snapshots under full-suite contention
issue.description: Proposed by phase bead sase-cz.5 while landing epic sase-cz. On master dd862b767, the four tests in tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_agents_retry_e2e.py all pass through the dedicated just test-visual lane, but a four-worker full just check fails test_real_fakey_retry_countdown_png_snapshot, test_real_loader_plan_family_retry_countdown_png_snapshot, and test_real_fakey_running_fallback_png_snapshot after the rest of the suite has exercised shared TUI/renderer state (25,158 tests passed). Reproduce under full-suite contention, inspect .pytest_cache/sase-visual actual/expected/diff/source artifacts, and stabilize fixture convergence or shared-state isolation without accepting flaky goldens.

payload.close_reason: Let's let this flake slide for now.

evidence.note:
ESCALATION, reproduced on a tree that already contains this bead's 2026-08-01 close. Reported by the land agent for epic sase-kv (proposed by phase bead sase-kv.5 at 2026-08-13T14:26:25Z).

This bead was canceled with 'Let's let this flake slide for now' on the premise -- stated in its own description -- that 'the four tests ... all pass through the dedicated just test-visual lane' and fail only under four-worker full-suite contention. That premise no longer holds.

MEASUREMENT 2026-08-13, sase master 7e4ac6d7c, workspace sase_10, DEDICATED lane only:
  just test-visual tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_agents_retry_e2e.py
  run 1 -> 3 failed, 1 passed in 18.31s
  run 2 -> 3 failed, 1 passed
No contention, no full suite, no other tests in the process. It fails standalone, twice.

The failing set has also shifted since this bead was written:
  now failing: test_real_fakey_retry_countdown, test_real_fakey_running_fallback, test_real_fakey_completed_retry_chain
  then failing: test_real_fakey_retry_countdown, test_real_fakey_running_fallback, test_real_loader_plan_family_retry_countdown
test_real_loader_plan_family_retry_countdown now passes; test_real_fakey_completed_retry_chain has taken its place.

WHY --sase-update-visual-snapshots CANNOT FIX THIS (the key new datum): the diff is large but not byte-stable across identical runs. .pytest_cache/sase-visual summary.txt for agents_retry_e2e_completed_chain_120x40 reported changed_pixels 62754 (material_diff_ratio 0.041271) on run 1 and 62862 (0.041290) on run 2, same 1482x1026 frame. Re-goldening records one sample of a moving target. That is consistent with phase sase-kv.5's report that these three still failed AFTER a full --sase-update-visual-snapshots refresh.

WHERE THE DIFF IS: entirely inside the agent-detail pane, not the agent tree or any tab strip. diff.png localizes it to the AGENT PROMPT body -- the retry continuation preamble from src/sase/llm_provider/retry_config.py:93 ('Your previous attempt hit a model context limit or transient provider failure...') rendered above the fixture prompt 'Exercise the retry pipeline.' (tests/fakey/harness.py:364) -- plus one short numeric field near the top of that pane. The text re-wraps between runs, which is what produces the ~4% pixel delta.

NOT CAUSED BY EPIC sase-kv, checked three ways: (1) commit 7e4ac6d7c refreshed 213 PNG goldens and none of them are retry/fakey goldens -- these five were last touched by 81e7b02d6 on 2026-08-10, before the epic; (2) the epic changed only the Artifacts sub-tab strip, and text extracted from actual.svg confirms these frames render the Agents pane with Artifacts as an unopened top-level tab, so the new sub-tab icons never draw; (3) PanelTabStrip's new behavior is inert without a non-empty icon or reflow_to_fit=True, neither of which this pane passes.

RELATED: sase-ct is the retired ACE-TUI-flake umbrella and was deliberately not +1'd. Its close-out policy routes contention flakes to narrow new beads, but this is not a contention flake -- the dedicated lane is red on its own, which is the specific condition this bead was created to protect and which has now regressed. Its guidance to re-measure with just test-visual-contention still applies to whoever picks this up.

payload.entry: Triage sweep 2026-08-14 (master 443566f7d, workspace sase_13). Ran 'tools/selection_health --fail-on-new-flake' against the durable store (901 scoped + 922 full-lane records, 30-day retention). It names exactly 12 reproducible flakes exceeding tests/reproducible_flake_baseline.txt, and none of these beads' nodes are among them: not test_agents_slow_tool_calls_fold_levels_png_snapshots (sase-cx), not the four test_ace_png_snapshots_agents_retry_e2e.py nodes (sase-dc), and not the three tests/monitor/test_monitor_supervise.py rows (sase-lk, whose nodes still exist and still collect). sase-cx and sase-dc were single unreproduced full-suite observations from 2026-07-31/08-01. The live gate debt is tracked by sase-jq (5 of the 12 nodes) and sase-lc (the dirty-workspace mechanism). Refile with a +1 carrying a fresh failing record if any of these resurfaces.

payload.close_reason: Not among the flakes currently blocking the check-full gate; closing stale flake reports in favor of live ones.
